en.headline: COVID vaccine for children arrives, free jabs start Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the Spikevax XFG mRNA vaccine for ages six months to 11 years is in Hong Kong, with booking opening at noon tomorrow.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said COVID-19 vaccines for children aged six months to 11 years have arrived in Hong Kong under the government’s vaccination programme.

Appointments for eligible infants and children can be made from noon on Tuesday through the government’s online booking platform. Parents may also book via the eHealth mobile app for children already registered with the system. Free vaccinations will begin on Thursday, 29 October.

Controller of the Centre for Health Protection Dr Edwin Tsui said scientific evidence shows the vaccines can effectively reduce the risk of severe illness and death. The government procured the Spikevax XFG mRNA vaccine following recommendations from the World Health Organization and the joint scientific committees for the 2026/27 season.

Children aged six months to four years who have never been infected are recommended to receive two doses at least 28 days apart to complete the initial series. Those aged five or above, or younger children with prior infection, need only one dose. Vaccinations are available at designated maternal and child health centres, student health service centres, Hong Kong Children’s Hospital and private clinic stations.

zh.headline: 供兒童接種新冠疫苗抵港 周四起免費接種
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心表示，供6個月至11歲兒童使用的Spikevax XFG疫苗已運抵本港，市民可明日中午起預約。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心表示，政府新冠疫苗接種計劃下供6個月大至11歲兒童接種的疫苗已經運抵本港。
市民可由明日（星期二）中午12時起，透過政府網上預約平台為合資格幼兒及兒童預約。已為子女登記醫健通的家長，亦可透過醫健通手機應用程式預約。免費接種服務將由星期四（10月29日）開始。
中心總監徐樂堅醫生說，科學證據顯示新冠疫苗可有效減低重症及死亡風險。政府已按世界衛生組織及聯合科學委員會建議，採購供兒童使用的Spikevax XFG信使核糖核酸疫苗。
6個月至4歲未曾感染新冠的幼兒，建議接種兩劑以完成初始劑次，兩劑間隔最少28天。5歲或以上人士，或較年幼但曾感染的兒童，只需接種一劑。接種地點包括指定母嬰健康院、學生健康服務中心、香港兒童醫院及私家診所接種站。
